items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs. Bears.
items.why: Official ruling from team via Schefter/Rapoport.
items.implication: Braelon Allen expected workhorse role and top waiver priority.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries for Allen; Jets RB committee collapses to Allen.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels officially out Sunday; Marcus Mariota will start vs. Colts.
items.why: Coach Dan Quinn made it official; elbow recovery not ready.
items.implication: Mariota starts; Commanders pass game downgrade, check TE/WR volume shifts.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to play Week 4 vs Eagles; limited practice progressing to full, McVay optimistic, no surgery expected.
items.why: McVay/OC comments + practice progression; Schefter earlier context.
items.implication: Elite WR1 return; Adams volume may normalize.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets as WR1 with Stafford.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on IR due to hamstring; minimum four games.
items.why: Coach Kellen Moore confirmed IR placement.
items.implication: Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller handle bulk RB snaps/carries.
items.opportunity: Expanded role for Kamara (RB35) and Miller (RB46) in NO backfield.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% with Sampson healthy); on pace for 64 catches after 26 last year.
items.why: 4-game sample target-share/pace data with teammate absence.
items.implication: Judkins receiving upside elevated; stronger PPR/flex candidate ROS.
items.opportunity: Higher route/target share in CLE backfield without Sampson.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): 90% snap rate last week, 20/22 RB touches; workhorse with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game.
items.implication: Top-10 RB play this week; start with confidence.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career tgt share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.opportunity: Hyper-targeted role with Penix under center.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; 36% tgt share last time Mitchell sidelined; 78% catch rate, 9.0 YPT; CHI allows 14+ YPR.
DeVonta Smith (hamstring) DNP multiple days, unlikely/not expected to play Week 4 vs Rams; beneficiaries Dontayvion Wicks etc.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs + reports of unlikely availability.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth elevated; Wicks/others see more targets.

items.text: Fresh ETR ROS Top-150: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall; other notables Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30.
items.why: Post-Week 3 ROS re-rank with Walker elite.
items.implication: Strong buy/hold; high weekly and ROS priority.
items.opportunity: Assumed lead role/usage sustaining top-tier production.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 utilization, 3.5% tgt share, 25% routes, snap rate dropped to 42%; SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage + tough run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% tgt share/34 ypg career with Penix; under 8 FP in 9/13 Penix games; TE37 utilization.
HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA: 44% pressure rate, SEA 4th in pressure/allows league-low 5.0 YPA; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Pressure + tough pass D + low total.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs vs WSH: 31% tgt share last two, 43% red-zone looks; WSH allows most FP/TDs to WRs and slot.
